enGB:
A champion spirit is a paragon of skill at arms.
Spirit Bonus: When you channel a champion, your spirit bonus applies on attack rolls, non-spell damage rolls, Strength checks, Strength-based skill checks, and Fortitude saves.
Seance Boon: You gain a +2 bonus on all non-spell damage rolls.
Influence Penalty: You take a penalty equal to your spirit bonus on Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks, and to your caster level (to a minimum of caster level 0); as usual, a reduced caster level may render you unable to cast spells.
Champion's Prowess (Lesser, Su): You gain proficiency in all martial and exotic weapons.
Sudden Attack (Intermediate, Su): Whenever you take a full-attack action, you gain one additional attack at your highest base attack bonus. This ability stacks with the extra attack from haste, but it doesn't stack with special actions that grant extra attacks, such as flurry of blows or spell combat. Sudden attack works as normal with full-attack options such as twoweapon fighting.
Fleet Charge (Greater, Su): Spend a swift action and a standard action to make a full attack against one enemy within your weapon's range. This ability works with Sudden Attack, haste, and two-weapon fighting. It does not grant movement; you can use your normal move action before or after the attack.
Legendary Champion (Supreme, Su): You gain Armor and Weapon Training as per the fighter.
In this mod, Legendary Champion grants two ranks in every fighter weapon-training group available in the game.
zhCN:
勇士英灵是武艺的典范。
英灵同调：降灵勇士时，你的英灵同调适用于攻击检定、非法术伤害掷骰、力量检定、基于力量的技能检定，以及强韧豁免。
降灵奖励：你的所有非法术伤害掷骰获得+2加值。
共鸣惩罚：你的智力检定、基于智力的技能检定，以及施法者等级承受等同于英灵同调的减值（施法者等级最低降至0）。与通常情况相同，降低施法者等级可能使你无法施法。
斗士之威（次级，超自然）：你擅长所有军用武器和异种武器。
瞬袭（中等，超自然）：每当你进行整轮攻击时，你都能以最高基本攻击加值额外攻击一次。此能力可与加速术提供的额外攻击叠加，但不能与疾风连击、法术战斗等提供额外攻击的特殊动作叠加。瞬袭可以正常配合双武器战斗等整轮攻击选项使用。
Fleet Charge (Greater, Su): Spend a swift action and a standard action to make a full attack against one enemy within your weapon's range. This ability works with Sudden Attack, haste, and two-weapon fighting. It does not grant movement; you can use your normal move action before or after the attack.
传奇勇士（至高，超自然）：你获得战士职业的防具训练和武器训练能力。
本模组中，传奇勇士给予游戏现有全部战士武器训练组各两级。
